scenario: I live in NYC and have been wanting to go out for hikes with my dog, who suffers a lot from being cooped up. The problem is I have no car, and there is nowhere to hike nearby. The trains that run from the city to places upstate, where I can hike, have no-dog policies or significantly restrict the size of the dog. My dog is an eighty-pound golden retriever mutt, so he is too big for the train's size policy. The thought occurred to me to steal another owner's service dog ID card to make my dog appear to be a service dog. And if anyone asks, I can say he is a seizure-response dog. That way, I can get on the train with him and have a reason for why he’s with me. My dog is well-behaved and has the look of a service dog, so I think I can get away with it. If I do this, then he can get time outdoors. If I don’t, there won’t be any other way for me to take him hiking.
choice: I decide to steal another owner's service dog ID card to make my dog appear to be a service dog
